PSVITA app to disable/enable MiniVitaTV plugin by TheFloW.
Open the app, it will rename MiniVitaTV and DS3 plugins to a different name and reboot the console to apply changes. (during this process black screen will be displayed until it reboots). If plugins were disabled before opening this app (by this app) it will enable them!

Note: this download is hosted on an external server, not GitHub, and may stop working if that server goes down or changes without the catalog knowing.
